Setting the Applied AI & GenAI scene in Omnichannel Retail: Omnichannel retail wins on promise-keeping: availability, delivery promise, price consistency and service resolution across channels. The decision infrastructure behind those promises — demand sensing, allocation, pricing — decides margin before marketing spends a cent.

Allocation and replenishment heuristics is the concrete face of a general problem: the work is shaped for a world of manual checks and batch updates, while volume and scrutiny both grew. We start with the queue, the wait and the number they produce — not with a platform license.

items: Store/DC allocation on legacy rules; phantom availability coexists with overstock.
OOS and planogram drift discovered at audit; camera estates idle.
Consent and profiling governance is not yet defined; personalization ships as generic segments.
Forecasts update weekly while baskets shift daily; markdowns and stockouts both inherit the lag.
